exchange: Binance USD-M, all archived and current USDT perpetuals, all underlyings
lifecycle: Cut at known delivery, and break long flat-price intervals where exchange turnover or trade counts verify inactivity. Do not carry positions across a dormant listing.
anchor: Pine V1.5, first complete Monday-Sunday in New York, exact continuous H1 coverage; upper=H+0.618*(H-L), lower=L-0.618*(H-L).
signal: First post-confirmation reach per symbol, NY month and rail. Closed UTC 00/12 aligned 12h bar must finish strictly back on the inward side before NY month expiry. No wick size or open filter. Never re-arm the rail. Require observable history from anchor confirmation to first touch.
entry: Immediately following H1 open at the 12h close. Count confirmed opportunities separately from executable entries.
exits: Price risk from actual entry to protective stop, independent targets, allow cross-month holds. Trace until stop, target, tape gap or dataset end. Nonpositive short objectives cannot hit. Range targets already passed at entry are recorded separately.
execution: VectorBT. Gap opens have precedence. H1 double touches use the 60 reconciled Binance trading minutes when available. Remaining one-minute ties or unavailable minute data default to stop first; ambiguity is retained.
control: One seeded uniform other UTC 12h decision clock in the observable same instrument and NY active range month per entry, matching long/short and percentage stop distance. Seed 20261115 plus stable event key. Compare fixed-R targets across paired cohorts.
